description: This file defines the implementation of the ConstantUnion class used for constant folding and type operations within the ANGLE project's shader translator. It includes methods for arithmetic operations, type casting, and validation specific to shader constant handling.

classes.name: TConstantUnion
classes.description: Represents a shader constant value with methods for type casting, comparison, and arithmetic operations.

methods.name: CheckedSum
methods.description: Performs addition with overflow and NaN checks, issuing warnings via diagnostics.

methods.name: CheckedDiff
methods.description: Performs subtraction with overflow and NaN checks, issuing warnings via diagnostics.

methods.name: CheckedMul
methods.description: Performs multiplication with overflow and NaN checks, issuing warnings via diagnostics.

methods.name: IsValidShiftOffset
methods.description: Validates if a shift offset is within the permissible range (0-31).
